Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.


Job Summary:  

The Entry Mechanical Engineer is responsible for assisting in the design and development of processes for manufacturing chemicals and related products. This role involves working under the guidance of experienced engineers, conducting research, analyzing data, and contributing to the optimization of production processes.  

  

Responsibilities:  

  

Research and Development  

* Conduct experiments and trials to develop new chemical processes or products
* Analyze data and interpret results to make recommendations for improvement
* Collaborate with other engineers and scientists to design and implement new processes

  

Process Design and Optimization  

* Design and optimize chemical processes and equipment for maximum efficiency and productivity
* Troubleshoot and resolve any issues with current processes
* Continuously improve processes through data analysis and implementation of new technologies

  

Quality Control  

* Implement quality control measures to ensure products meet safety and regulatory standards
* Monitor and analyze production processes to identify any potential quality issues
* Develop and implement solutions to improve product quality and consistency

  

Project Management  

* Plan and manage projects related to new product development, process optimization, and quality control
* Coordinate with cross functional teams to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget
* Communicate project updates and progress to stakeholders and upper management

  

Safety and Environmental Compliance  

* Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and protocols in the Mechanical Engineering industry
* Develop and implement safety procedures for handling and disposal of hazardous materials
* Stay updated on environmental regulations and make recommendations for sustainable practices

* Basic knowledge of chemical process engineering and safety regulations.
* Proficiency in data analysis and simulation software.
